crime: In the courtyard, {WITCH_NAME} refused to help a girl film herself with her phone. Then she gave the girl a lecture on moths. It was the first time anyone had listened.

Today, the girl mocked her by mimicking that lecture, then announced she would stream the imitation to the prisoners that afternoon. During afternoon free time, {WITCH_NAME} followed her into the forest while the girl rehearsed it. There, she used her Magic to change from human form into a wolf. Before the stream could start, she mauled the girl with the wolf's jaws, leaving fatal wounds in her throat.

At first, the prisoners blamed her death on a wild wolf. But one prisoner traced the attack trail and found human footprints changing into wolf pawprints. Those changing tracks exposed the “wild attack” as {WITCH_NAME}'s deliberate hunt in animal form.
fields.epitaph: At last she had an audience, but no one saw who she had been.
execution: The execution stand lays the witch flat on her back across a specimen board, holding her limbs spread. A specimen pin drives through her chest and into the board. She struggles against it until her body goes still, mounted for display.

magic.name: Animal Shapeshifting
magic.text: She can transform into an animal of her choice and use its natural abilities.
